description: Central package registry for A2 / Active Oberon community libraries (CPAN/Maven-style). Install with `ob get`.

community/matrix.summary: Dense/complex linear algebra, ML, wavelets, PDE, statistics (Hunziker). Headless numeric core.

community/work.summary: Assorted tools/experiments; manifest + headless/GUI split TODO.

community/octk.summary: OCTK toolkit — source in binary Oberon-Text format; compiler reads it, text analysis/manifest-gen needs interface extraction.

community/sr.summary: sr voxel/raytracer engine — binary format + GUI (WMWindowManager/WMGraphics).

notes.ocp_extras: a2oberon/ocp adds 33 modules not in A2Community (Rubik, VolumeRaytracer, Wedgelets, Miniscript, ants*, ...) — union candidates.
notes.binary_format: OCTK/Reanimator/sr are stored in A2 binary Text format. `ob compile`/`ob doc` READ it fine (Fox has a Text subsystem); only grep/python text analysis and manifest auto-generation are blocked — those need interface extraction (compile then read .SymUu, or Text->ASCII export).
notes.embedded_excluded: a2oberon/ARM (73 modules: Enet stack, DMA330, Zynq EMAC) is a bare-metal/embedded track, not a library — excluded from this registry.
